evidence.reason: The rollback branch restores the unit snapshot and then calls preservation_check with identity["state"], which was captured after the initial stop_and_drain but before install/start (lines 1852-1855 and 1882-1885). For an issuing unit, a successful activation completion advances heartbeat.json, so that pre-activation baseline is stale by the time rollback runs. The check therefore raises before adapter.restore_activation, producing recovery_required; the recovery record retains the same stale state, so the same check cannot pass. The fix is to capture and persist the preserved-surface digests after the rollback stop_and_drain and before adapter.restore, then check restore against that new baseline. The pre-install check remains appropriate.
